#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "Starting malware cleanup patch application at $(date)"

# Verify security patch script exists
if [ ! -f "./security_patch.py" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Required file security_patch.py not found in current working directory!"
    exit 1
fi

# Verify python3 is available on the system
if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: python3 runtime is required but not installed on this system!"
    exit 1
fi

# Execute the security patch with any passed arguments
echo "Launching security_patch.py..."
python3 ./security_patch.py "$@"

echo "✅ Patch application completed successfully at $(date)"
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "Starting malware cleanup patch application at $(date)"

# Verify security patch script exists
if [ ! -f "./security_patch.py" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Required file security_patch.py not found in current working directory!"
    exit 1
fi

# Verify python3 is available on the system
if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: python3 runtime is required but not installed on this system!"
    exit 1
fi

# Execute the security patch with any passed arguments
echo "Launching security_patch.py..."
python3 ./security_patch.py "$@"

echo "✅ Patch application completed successfully at $(date)"
exit 0
